# Journal Information
_Communications Physics_ is an open access journal from Nature Portfolio publishing high-quality research, reviews and commentary in all areas of physics. Research papers published by the journal represent significant advances bringing new insight to a specialized area of research. _Communications Physics_ complements the other Nature Portfolio journals by providing a new open access option for physicists while applying less stringent criteria for impact and significance than the Nature-branded journals, including _Nature Communications_.
_Communications Physics_ publishes primary research Articles (both full and shorter papers), Reviews, Comments, and Matters Arising. A guide to our content types can be found [here](http://www.nature.com/commsphys/submit/content-types).
All Nature Portfolio journals, including _Communications Physics_ , apply the same criteria for technical validity and adherence to ethical standards. More information about editorial policies at Nature Portfolio can be found [here](https://www.nature.com/commsphys/editorial-policies).
Visit the pages in this section for specific information about our [aims and scope](https://www.nature.com/commsphys/aims), [journal metrics](https://www.nature.com/commsphys/journal-impact), the _Communications Physics_ [editors](https://www.nature.com/commsphys/editors) and [editorial board](https://www.nature.com/commsphys/editorial-board) and the benefits of [open access](https://www.nature.com/commsphys/open-access) publishing.
**Why publish in _Communications Physics?_**
  * Publishing significant advances across all areas of physics.
  * Committed to rapid dissemination of primary research, reviews, and comments.
  * Bringing high visibility through open access and a global reach.
